title: A MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND on a FRAUD charged-off loan credits CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 367.00, INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST 20.00 and INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES 113.00 (fee 103.00 + penalty 10.00 merged), then debits the resolved fund source 1 500.00 exactly ONCE (loan 16 L48)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF and FRAUD, the fraud principal split of createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the ChargeOff-Part1 MNT capture (tenant tierd, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, loan 16, loanProductId 3, chargedOff true, fraud true) at refund transaction L48. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.transaction_id is L48, kind is merchant_issued_refund and fraud is true. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's merchantIssuedRefund transaction id 48 (externalId c07b2808-e3b3-4260-82ca-42d787a959d2, type Merchant Issued Refund id 21, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 5 AUTOPAY, manuallyReversed false): principalPortion 367.0 -> "36700", interestPortion 20.0 -> "2000", feeChargesPortion 103.0 -> "10300", penaltyChargesPortion 10.0 -> "1000", overpaymentPortion 0 -> "0". request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.accounts is the product's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel, read from product-mappings/create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (sha256 d799095b...) and the oracle's echo product-mappings/product-20-retrieve-one-response.json (sha256 c01fa811...): chargeOffExpenseAccountId 14, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 20, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 11, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 11, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17, fundSourceAccountId 1; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so paymentType 5 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 1. expect.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the four L48 legs in id order from journalentries/loan-16/loan-16-journalentries-3.json: JE 136 CREDIT glAccountId 13 367.0 (Credit Loss/Bad Debt-Fraud), JE 137 CREDIT glAccountId 20 20.0 (Interest Income Charge Off), JE 138 CREDIT glAccountId 11 113.0 (Fee Charge Off; the 103.0 fee and 10.0 penalty portions MERGE into one credit at the first slot's position), JE 139 DEBIT glAccountId 1 500.0 (Suspense/Clearing account). THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a merchant-issued refund on a charged-off FRAUD loan credits the principal portion to CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 13 (not the ordinary charge-off expense 14), the interest to INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST 20, the fee and penalty portions MERGED into one 113.00 credit to INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES 11, and debits the total 500.00 exactly ONCE to the RESOLVED fund source 1. A port that ignores the fraud flag routes the 367.00 principal credit to account 14, moving that one account cell while every side, amount, the merged fee/penalty credit and the single fund-source debit stay observed. The merchant-issued and payout refund arms post IDENTICALLY, so this observation and the loan-17 payout observation grade the same legs. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive overpayment portion (zero here), the goodwill-credit arm (a different account table), a zero-total case, or the transaction kind beyond admission. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
